hero.title: A whole new look
hero.text: The menu is glass now, in 7 colours. Extras are tiles you can switch on with one click, and Player Outline got a Neon Glow.

items: Glass menu in 7 colours, Halloween included
Extras as tiles, Neon Glow player outline
Draw your own textures in My Drawings
Halloween capes, Pumpkin Head, Witch Hat, auras
Animated items also work with Sodium Extra
Export a preset as a texture pack (VIP)
Capes with Wavey Capes, grass colour
Auto updater: new versions show a download button
Hit Color, Low Fire, Fog and Grey world
